findings.description: src/local_ports.py:508 and :675 apply _strings/_text metadata-label constraints to CommandDefinition.argv and CommandEvidence.argv_redacted. A whitespace-significant argument '  payload  ' and multiline Python -c code both validate against frozen v1 schemas and execute successfully through shell=False argv, but both DTOs raise ValueError. This prevents TASK-006 from executing and accurately recording valid fixed command definitions through its required port.
findings.expected_fix: Separate argv validation from metadata labels. Preserve permitted argument contents exactly, including significant surrounding whitespace and embedded newlines, while retaining immutable sequences and schema constraints; handle process-invalid NUL at the appropriate boundary. Add both DTO regressions and update the handoff with actual repair evidence. No new schema fields or public signatures are required.
